description: Shared cases for CONTRACT.md, Showing links, The pages repair what they can. fragments: input is the text after the first # of the URL, want is the repaired fragment. pastes: input is the text the person pasted, want is the fragment read from it (without #), or null when there is none. The contract test checks every case against the rules; the pages' tests run them.

fragments.name: a clean long link is unchanged
format 1 is read too
underscores and hyphens are never removed
a trailing period is dropped
a trailing parenthesis is dropped
a trailing quote is dropped
trailing text after a comma is dropped
an encoded space is removed
encoded line breaks and tabs are removed in either case
a line break and indentation are removed
a carriage return and a tab are removed
a quote marker on a wrapped line is removed
emphasis stars are removed
a Markdown escape before an underscore is removed
a no-break space is removed
a line separator is removed
a clean short link is unchanged
a short link keeps 22 characters and drops a trailing period
a wrapped short link is joined
a cut short link is left to fail
an unknown prefix is left to fail
an empty fragment stays empty
a hash link keeps h= and its 22 characters
a hash link wrapped by a terminal

pastes.name: a terminal-wrapped and indented long link ends at the empty line
pastes.input:

pastes.name: a Markdown escape inside the link
a line with a space stops the link
a character that ends the line's run stops the link
a short link stops at 22 characters
a lone carriage return ends a line
a line separator ends a line
text after the link on the same line is dropped
only the fragment is taken, not the pasted origin or path
a hash link in the agent's message
